title: Meta Hack
tagline: FFNFTs lending - Fungible Fractional NFTs lendiing, the best way to unlock the value of NFTs
description: This project unlock the value and potential of NFTs, set them free,instead of sitting in wallet and do nothing. We turn Erc721 to Erc20, make it fungible and fractional, and offer a lending service for the tokens. After the hackathon, we will continue building the eco system for the FFNFTs.
how_its_made: This project uses solidity to write smart contracts. React.js to build the frontend, ethers.js to do the integrations. For wallet integration we utilize wallet connect. The smart contracts are deployed to Polygon and Bobas behind the scenes. We impressed ourselves as we are building the foundation for the growth of the metaverse industry.
